# `silk/native_process`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Source-owned native process resources and per-invocation capture policy.

## Details

Each invocation owns its descriptors, staged request bytes and child. Recoverable failures
release descriptors and resolve the child before propagating the original error.

## Gotchas

Foreign calls are blocking. Fatal traps do not promise cleanup or child termination.
